quotes.join_note: HotSpawn 'Zetta' = Kalshi 'Alianza Lima Esports': identical five-man roster (zockie, Slayerhz, NotJuanjo, BabyRage, Antuanette), same CCT SA Series 7 round-5 slot, same 22:00Z kick-off. Kalshi's own rules text: 'originally scheduled for Oct 21, 2026 at 6:00 PM EDT' = 22:00Z.
caveats: Zero traded volume and zero open interest: the quote is a market-maker ladder, not a traded consensus. The two-way spread is wide (0.16 on Los Ninos, 0.08 on Alianza).

Kalshi's own occurrence_datetime for this event (2026-10-22T02:00:00Z) is four hours later than the kick-off stated in the same market's rules text (Oct 21 6:00 PM EDT = 22:00Z). The rules text and HotSpawn agree, so 22:00Z is used.
Disagreement disclosed on the site: our Valve-VRS origination and bo3.gg's own model both favour Zetta, while this exchange quote favours Los Ninos.
